minority_phase.note: Replaces equal host mass in108t total, unlike added caps incycle23; neither material prices nor50C stiffness established. No conversion/shape processing cost included.

thermal.note: All thermo coefficients and190C process scenario assumed, not an SCPLA recipe. Whole processed grain heated; only chosen low phase latent heat included. Heater losses lumped efficiency; cooling equipment/drying/kinetics excluded. Heat diffusion time d^2/alpha order-of-magnitude, not exact transient solution. Reference thermal table isH24-A with10percent low-melting phase. Joint material-cost cases recompute H24-B low-melting host as1 minus high-price phase fraction; they never reuseH24-A latent heat.

phase_drift.note: Conserved two-state proxy: eligible mixed low-melting material converts to high-melting phase; not measured kinetics or universal stereochemistry. No loss or replenishment. High phase mass rises exactly as low phase falls. In actual grain opposite enantiomer supply and interface diffusion limit conversion.
